title: -(으)므로 causa formal
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL guide defines **-(으)므로** as expressing a reason or basis, especially in formal and written contexts. It documents examples where the following clause is a command or proposal, unlike **-기 때문에**. This entry is limited to that register and clause-type contrast.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). *한국어교육 문법·표현 내용 개발 연구(3단계) [Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3)]*. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do;front=B5CD4F10151810563982D51A3FD4329B?c_file_name=5a2db2bc-a7ad-49f4-84a4-34b20ad33ffc_0.pdf&file_path=reportData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EA%B5%90%EC%9C%A1+%EB%AC%B8%EB%B2%95%ED%91%9C%ED%98%84+%EB%82%B4%EC%9A%A9%EA%B0%9C%EB%B0%9C+%EC%97%B0%EA%B5%AC_3%EB%8B%A8%EA%B3%84.pdf

Research on the Development of Korean Grammar and Expression Content (Stage 3), PDF pp. 278–280 (printed pp. 266–268): formation, register, and comparison with -기 때문에/-(으)니까.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-아/어서**, **때문에** y **-기 때문에** como recursos causales, pero se distingue por su registro y por su frecuente función argumentativa o justificativa. También puede compararse con **-(으)ㄴ/는 탓에** y **-(으)ㄴ/는 바람에**, que añaden matices adversos ausentes de **-(으)므로**.
